summary: An advanced chip packaging plant planned by US firm 3D Glass Solutions at Info Valley near Bhubaneswar, Odisha, combining glass panel substrate production, package assembly and 3D heterogeneous integration modules for AI, high-performance computing, defence and other electronics. The Union Cabinet approved it under the India Semiconductor Mission in August 2025, and the government lists the investment as INR 1,943 crore. The state's chief minister and the Union electronics and IT minister laid its foundation stone on 19 April 2026. Trade press reports that the Indian subsidiary running the project aims for commercial production by August 2028 and full volume by August 2030.

location.note: The state government places the site at Info Valley in Khordha district; the same location hosts SiCSem's approved compound semiconductor fab.

metrics.note: INR 1,943 crore; the state government rounds it to about INR 2,000 crore.
Glass panel substrates per month, about 69,600 a year.
Assembled package units per month, given elsewhere as 50 million a year.
3D heterogeneous integration modules per month, about 13,200 a year.
Employment the state government expects in Odisha.

notes: The investment is below USD 500 million; the unit is included because the government's approval and announcements describe it as advanced packaging with 3D heterogeneous integration on glass substrates. A May 2026 memorandum between the Odisha government, Intel and 3DGS on bringing substrate manufacturing to India is a separate effort and is not part of this record, since substrate plants fall outside the dataset. Reports after the groundbreaking give no construction progress.
